sideA.summary: Congratulations. This is the end of the Legacy deck for Pandemic Legacy: Season 2. Updates and community info are at www.ZManGames.com.
sideA.text:
CONGRATULATIONS!

You have reached the end of the Legacy deck for Pandemic Legacy: Season 2. We hope you enjoyed the experience. For the latest updates and community info, visit www.ZManGames.com.

sideB.summary: Warning. This is the end of the Legacy deck. Start from the other side of the deck.
sideB.text:
WARNING!

THIS IS THE END OF THE LEGACY DECK.
PLEASE START FROM THE OTHER SIDE OF THE DECK.

mechanics.whenRead: Last card in the Legacy deck. Side A is the face at the end of a campaign. Side B is the warning if the deck is turned around and this card is drawn first.
rules: Side B: this is the end of the Legacy deck. Start from the other side of the deck.
mechanics.notes: Both sides are red with yellow type. 12-13b is the wrong-end warning, not a second ending.
